name: commontrace
description: CommonTrace knowledge base integration for Claude Code agents. Auto-searches for relevant traces at session start, provides /trace:search, /trace:contribute and /trace:brain commands.

api_key.title: CommonTrace API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave blank and an anonymous read-only key is provisioned automatically on first run — enough to search and read the commons. Paste a contributor key here to publish traces, or pass it at install time with: claude plugin install commontrace@commontrace --config api_key=...
